videos.desc: Two teenage boys lean over a wooden table with their elbows on it, watching a black plastic battle dish. Inside it a yellow spinning top and a purple spinning top race around the bowl, knock into each other and keep spinning, and both boys grin and laugh as they follow them.

On a wide sunny beach a young woman in a bikini swings her arm and sends a small ball flying up over the sand. The shot cuts to a yellow ball high against the blue sky over the surf, then to her standing with legs apart and both arms raised as a watermelon-patterned ball drops towards her hands. A large red, white and blue beach ball sails through the air while a man runs under it, and finally she laughs as a rainbow-striped ball comes back at her and the man lands in the sand behind.

Over the top of a camera on a tripod, a woman in a striped summer dress stands smiling on a sunlit park lawn under tall trees. Cut to a macro shot of round dew drops beading along a green leaf in a flower bed. Then two hands hold up a black DSLR with a big flash on top and shoot into a sunset over rolling hills, the sun low and orange on the horizon. The same shot holds as the sun drops further. Finally a young man in a straw hat and green shirt turns a big black camera with a long lens towards the viewer at a red-carpet event.

A woman in a big cardigan and glasses leans over a table scattered with jigsaw pieces in a bright room full of plants and bookshelves. She picks up single pieces and presses them into the picture, the puzzle grows onto the wall, and finally it covers the whole floor as she fits the last pieces in the middle.

A woman in a field vest and big headphones holds a furry microphone and a handheld recorder close to a singing bird in a wood. She crouches to record a stream over stones, raises a long boom microphone up into the green canopy, and finally records beside a thundering waterfall, beaming.

A young woman with curly hair draws a swirling logo letter on a tablet with a stylus at a sunny desk. She then stands over a table fanned out with dozens of colour swatch cards and smiles at the camera. At an iMac she arranges a colourful poster layout with a colour wheel open beside it. A hand turns a sketchbook page showing a pencil drawing of a woman in a long flowing gown. Finally she poses in front of a huge colourful mural in a gallery while visitors look at it.
videos.said: Ooh, nice. This one. Perfect. Love it. Ta-da!

videos.desc: A young man sits on a bench in a city plaza between office towers, playing a wooden acoustic instrument with six strings, one hand on the fretboard, the other strumming over the sound hole. A runner in a race bib jogs past. Office workers with shopping bags stop and gather in a half circle around him, clapping and smiling; a toddler dances in front; two people hold up phones to film him as he keeps playing and singing.

A young woman in an oversized band T-shirt presses a pair of big headphones to her ears in a recording booth strung with warm fairy lights. She leans into a large studio microphone behind a pop filter and belts out a note with her eyes shut and her mouth wide open. A cut shows an older man at a mixing desk pushing the faders. She keeps singing with her arms flung out, then laughs and looks over at a screen where the man behind the glass is clapping.

A carnival parade fills a wide street hung with rainbow bunting between balconies packed with spectators. A woman in a huge rainbow feather headdress and a silver bodysuit walks down the centre line of the road at the front with her arms flung wide. Behind her, rows of drummers in white outfits and rainbow-striped trousers carry big rainbow-painted drums strapped at the waist and beat them with sticks as they advance, with a dense crowd stretching back down the street.

In a sunny park a young person in a rainbow tie-dye tracksuit bends down and picks up three pastel balls from the grass, then straightens up and juggles them in a smooth cascade. Three friends sit on the lawn behind and watch, smiling. The juggler grins wide as the balls arc above their head.

A young red-haired street performer in a denim jacket covered in enamel badges plays an acoustic guitar on a cobbled street at golden hour. An open guitar case lies on the stones in front of him. A small crowd of passers-by has stopped in a loose semicircle to listen, including a woman holding a toddler. He strums hard, throws his strumming hand up over his head, then leans back into the guitar and sings while the onlookers smile and clap.

In a flat with a huge political world map on the wall, housemates take turns stepping up to it. Each one holds a small square instant print showing their own face and a little paper flag, and presses both onto the map over the country they come from. A man in a green football shirt sticks his onto northern Europe, a woman with a camera round her neck presses hers onto Africa, a long-haired man adds one near Japan, a blonde woman adds one over South America. The map fills up with flags and small portraits, and at the end the whole group crowds behind the framed map, holds it up and takes a selfie with it.

Filmed from the seats of an old theatre, a play is being performed on the lit stage. A costumed actor with a moustache sits on a golden throne wearing a metal helmet while actors dressed as ragged peasants storm him with makeshift weapons. They tip the throne over and he tumbles onto a white mattress laid on the boards; a woman in rags holds the helmet up over her head and the whole auditorium rises, cheering and applauding.

A young travel vlogger films himself on a trip. First he walks beside a truck covered in bright hand-painted flowers with a peacock painted on its side, and puts his hand on it. Then he stands at a wooden railing under strings of prayer flags, looking out at a snow-covered mountain range lit orange by the sun above a deep valley. Finally, on a city rooftop at sunset with domes and minarets behind him, he holds a string and flies a red kite while dozens of coloured kites fill the sky around him.

A young blonde woman sits curled up on a grey sofa in a bright living room, a white curtained window behind her. She holds a thick paperback open in both hands and reads it, her lips moving slightly as her eyes track the lines. She smiles at something on the page and turns over a page. At the end she closes the book, holds it on her lap and looks up and away with a satisfied smile.

A woman in a fur-flapped hat and a burgundy winter coat stands with her arms spread wide in a snowy square in front of a cathedral with coloured onion domes. She is then on a train, holding a glass of black tea in a metal holder and sipping it while snow-covered birch woods slide past the window. Finally she is at an evening winter market strung with fairy lights, smiling as she twists open a small painted wooden doll and holds up the two halves and the smaller doll from inside it.

Four scenes of people performing music with words. A grey-haired busker plays an acoustic guitar and sings into a microphone on a cobbled Lisbon street while a crowd stands round listening. A woman in a colourful apron sings into a wooden spoon in her kitchen while pots simmer behind her. Four friends belt out a number together in a car at night with the city lights behind them. Finally a performer in a white suit sings into a microphone on a huge arena stage in front of a packed, floodlit crowd.

A figure skater in a navy outfit glides across an ice rink with one leg stretched out behind him, pulls his arms in to his chest and spins fast on one skate, then slows, straightens up and glides away across the ice.

A woman in a green velvet dress sits in the audience of a plain little hall, clapping as two men in waistcoats bow on a low wooden platform; she turns to the camera, delighted. Then she is alone in a large empty auditorium of red seats, looking up at the stage. Finally she leans on the red-and-gold rail of a box in a grand horseshoe-shaped opera house, a chandelier above her, tiers of gilded balconies around her and the orchestra playing in the pit below the closed red curtain.

A rehearsal on a small black theatre stage. A young man in a black T-shirt and trousers kneels in the middle, flinging his arms wide and throwing his head back as he cries out dramatically, with a wooden prop sword on the floor beside him. He then collapses backwards and lies flat on the stage. A spotlight on a stand throws his shadow onto a plain plywood backdrop. In the front row of grey seats a woman with a clipboard covers her face with her hand and laughs.

An elegant old café after closing time, with wood panelling, a brass chandelier and a herringbone parquet floor. Chairs are stacked upside down on the tables. A young waiter in a white shirt, black waistcoat and long black apron holds a straw broom like a dance partner and moves across the empty floor in a wide, graceful dance step, swings the broom round as he turns, then stops and stands with it, eyes closed and smiling dreamily. A bentwood chair stands in the foreground.

In a bright workshop by a window, a young woman with her braids in a high bun, wearing a cream jumper and a beige apron, pulls a petal off a pink rose she is making from fabric. Then she holds up two pink roses side by side, looks from one to the other and laughs. On the table are a glass jar of real pink roses, a box of handmade roses with green wire stems, loose petals, pink cloth, reels of green wire and small jars of powder. People work behind her.

In an empty, cracked outdoor swimming pool with blue tiles and weeds along the edge, in warm evening sun, a young man in a cream T-shirt and dark trousers flies through the air above the curved rim with a skateboard under his feet, trying a jump. He lands on the dry pool floor, where two skateboards already lie, rides across and up the far wall to the rim. Another young man in a blue T-shirt crouches at the edge with his board, watching closely, then stands and throws his arms up. A metal drain grate runs around the pool.

In a woodworking workshop with sunlight coming through a high window, a bearded man in a grey shirt and a worn canvas apron strikes a chisel with a wooden mallet and cuts a neat curl of wood from a beam on the workbench. He then leans in, lifts the chisel up and looks at its edge with a satisfied grin. Wood shavings and a neat row of chisels lie on the bench. Behind him four young men lean on their benches and watch closely. Saws and tools hang on the wall.

In a cosy living room in the evening, three young friends sit on a sofa around a wooden coffee table covered by a colourful board game with a map board, small wooden pieces and cards. A young woman with long braids in a lilac top and denim shorts watches the board, then jumps up and throws her arms in the air, cheering. A young man in a white polo shirt laughs and moves a piece on the board, and a young woman in a cream cardigan watches. A shelf of game boxes, a floor lamp and a tabby cat are around them.

On the stone stage of an open-air theatre on a cliff by the sea at dusk, an actor dressed as a Viking warrior, in a horned metal helmet, a fur cape, a long brown cloak and leather arm straps, shouts with his mouth wide open, swings a wooden staff high over his head and then plants it on the stage. A stagehand in black stands by the ropes on the left, footlights glow along the stage edge, and rows of people watch from the stone seats, with burning torches and crashing waves behind them.

In a dim attic room under a sloping roof with a skylight, a young woman in a cream cable-knit jumper with a grey blanket around her shoulders sits at an old upright piano. One hand plays the keys while the other writes notes on a sheet of music with a pencil; her breath shows in the cold air. A desk lamp and a mug stand on the piano, crumpled sheets of paper cover the floor and a pencil falls. At the end she smiles and keeps writing.

A sunny clifftop. A young woman with windblown dark hair, a yellow rain jacket and black leggings leans on a wooden fence, laughing as she takes pictures with a small silver compact digital camera, its strap dangling. She lowers it, pushes her hair from her face and raises it again. A backpack with a water bottle sits at her feet in the long grass and pink sea flowers. Behind her the turquoise sea sparkles, and a white lighthouse stands on a rocky islet just off the coast.

A bright white gallery with a glass roof. A young man with curly hair in a paint-stained T-shirt and grey trousers stands on a stepladder and blows at a large red disc of a big hanging sculpture of thin black wires with red, yellow, black and white discs. The sculpture starts to turn slowly in the air while he raises his hands and watches it with a smile. A young woman in black holds the ladder and looks up, and two visitors watch from a balcony above.

A one-man band on a cobbled old-town square on a sunny day. A young man in a cap and maroon shirt plays an acoustic guitar and blows a harmonica held in a holder at his mouth, with a cymbal and a drum strapped to his back and a tambourine tied to one foot. A young woman with a bicycle bends down to his open guitar case, then stands up and sings along, smiling. A small scruffy dog sits by the case, and pastel houses and a stone fountain stand behind.

A sunny street market with coloured bunting overhead. A young man walks towards the camera down the cobbled lane as a one-man band made from things at hand: he plays an acoustic guitar and a harmonica with a small horn at his mouth, a frying pan on a pole above his head, and a saucepan, spoons, a cheese grater and a tambourine swing from his body, with an old suitcase on his back. Behind him young people clap and cheer, and a young woman waves a bunch of tulips beside the fruit and flower stalls.

A wooden canoe on a calm lake at sunset, seen from the viewer's seat. The viewer's hands in white sleeves hold a bitten red apple and a fishing rod, with a leather bag at their feet. In a second canoe beside it a young woman in a coral T-shirt and denim shorts sits barefoot, drops a berry into her mouth, then relaxes with her eyes half closed. A loon dives under the water, leaving ripples, and a small cabin with a lit window stands among tall pine trees on the shore under a pink sky.

A cosy wooden pottery studio in winter. In the foreground, a potter's clay-covered hands shape a grey vase on a spinning wheel, and the wet clay rises fast between their fingers into a very tall, twisted vase. A young woman with two long braids, a cream sweater and paint-stained dungarees leans in, gasps and then grins with delight. A tabby cat on a shelf full of mugs and jugs reaches out a paw towards the vase. A bucket of slip stands beside the wheel, and snowy pine trees are visible through the window.

A relaxed summer afternoon under a big tree in a park by a lake. A young woman in a white blouse and yellow shorts lies back on cushions, laughs and stretches her arms. A young man in a blue vest top lies beside her and raises an arm, and a young man in an open white shirt swings gently in a striped hammock. A golden spaniel rests on the blanket and then lies down, next to a picnic basket, a jug of lemonade, grapes, books and a frisbee. A red and yellow kite flies overhead.

A cosy old bar with green tiled walls and brass lamps. In the foreground a woman in a royal blue jumper and gold bracelets plays an old upright wooden piano; only her arms and hands on the keys are visible. Beside her a young man in a brown satin shirt plays a golden saxophone with his eyes half closed. Behind them a young woman in a pink satin blouse sits on a bar stool, smiling and swaying her raised hand to the tune, and a grey cat sleeps on top of the piano next to a candle.

A small, crowded kitchen at night, lit by fairy lights. On the counter stands a row of glass bottles filled with water to different levels, and a laughing young woman in a rust jumper taps them with a spoon to play notes. Next to her a young man in a white shirt drums on cooking pots with wooden spoons. Behind them a young woman blows across the top of a bottle, and friends crowd round clapping and smiling. A man in a blue shirt watches from the doorway with his arms crossed and then covers his face.

A deep red rock canyon at sunset under dark clouds. A young man without a shirt, in orange shorts and a climbing harness, walks barefoot along a thin slackline high above the canyon, seen from behind. He keeps his arms stretched out for balance and slowly moves further along the line, which is anchored with metal clips to the rock in the foreground. A river winds far below between the cliffs, and a small green tree grows on the rocks at the side.

A concrete skatepark bowl at sunset, with palm trees, a pink sky and a colourful mural wall. A laughing young woman in a blue crop top and cream shorts rides her skateboard down into the bowl and swoops across it, her hair flying. On the edge lie the signs of a long day there: several empty water bottles, a paper bag, a jacket, a backpack and a row of worn wheels. A boxer dog rests by a boombox, and a young man sits on the edge with his board.

A young man in a dark jacket and a navy beanie skates slowly along the edge of an outdoor ice rink at dusk, one hand on the rail. A young woman in a dark red jacket stands in front of him with open hands. He lets go of the rail, spreads both arms wide and glides towards her, laughing, while she laughs with him. A lit Christmas tree, a carousel and strings of lights glow behind them. He holds the rail at first, but a moment later he skates with no hands.
